games.injuries: USF QB unresolved: Michael Van Buren Jr. (undisclosed injury) was ruled out on the AAC report and missed the ECU game; Luke Kromenhoek made his first start (USF Oracle, Nov 8). Brian Hartline hasn't named a starter. Memphis (Marcus Stokes at QB) is coming off a bye. Van Buren's absence predates the line, so no adjustment.
No reported absences confirmed yet in official or on-record reports; conference availability reports come Wednesday.

Florida State (interim coach Rick Stockstill): C Bradyn Welch-Joiner unavailable, DL Kevin Wynn not expected back, DL Deante McCray questionable; WR Duce Robinson and RB Ousmane Kromah out for the season (FSU On SI, Nov 9). Ashton Daniels starts at QB. Pitt QB Mason Heintschel out for the season (torn ACL, ESPN, Oct 3); Holden Geriner starts.

Illinois QB Katin Houser back from a broken hand (292 yds, 3 TD vs Nebraska, Chicago Sun-Times, Nov 6); RB Javari Barnett out for the season, C Jake Renfro could return (247Sports). UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava out for the season; Ty Dieffenbach starts. UCLA LT Jordan Davis was doubtful last week.
Houston QB Conner Weigman (ankle) 'full go' per Willie Fritz and played vs Cincinnati. Colorado QB Isaac Wilson started vs Arizona State (ESPN, Nov 8). No new absences confirmed.

Miami WR Malachi Toney out after ankle surgery (Mario Cristobal, Nov 8); Darian Mensah at QB. Duke out: WRs Jamien Little, Qeanu Johnson and Kavon Simmons, CB Kimari Robinson, LB Elliott Schaper, OL Kai Jacobwitz, Reagan McCranie and Roman Fina, K Cosme Salas, DL David Anderson (Ball Durham via Yahoo, Nov 10). Walker Eget starts at QB.

Wake Forest QB Gio Lopez (lower body) sat out vs Merrimack as a precaution; Jake Dickert is optimistic he plays (247Sports via RotoWire, Nov 8; Winston-Salem Journal). TE Will Loerzel hopeful, LB Aiden Hall day-to-day. SMU QB Kevin Jennings healthy. Lopez was expected back when the line opened, so no adjustment.

Notre Dame out: LB Drayk Bowen, CB DJ McKinney, S Brauntae Johnson; DL Francis Brewu and Jason Onye questionable; WR Jaden Greathouse (ribs) expected to play; CJ Carr starts (ABC57, Nov 9). BC C Michael Crounse (lower leg) hoped to return.

Ohio State QB Julian Sayin remains out; Luke Fahey starts, Ryan Day said Tuesday (WCMH via Yahoo, Nov 10). Northwestern QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) missed Iowa and could miss this game; Nicco Marchiol started (Yahoo, Nov 6/9). Both absences predate the line.

Indiana QB unresolved: Josh Hoover (arm, since Oct 17) gave way to Grant Wilson at Minnesota; Curt Cignetti wouldn't name a starter (ESPN, Nov 9). CB AJ Harris day-to-day. USC QB Jayden Maiava healthy.

Michigan QB 'TBD' between Bryce Underwood and Tommy Carr (Kyle Whittingham, Yahoo, Nov 9). Oregon QB Dante Moore out for the season; Dylan Raiola starts. LB Teitum Tuioti out for the season (Dan Lanning, Nov 10); WR Jeremiah McClellan back on limited snaps.
Alabama QB Keelon Russell (ankle taped late vs LSU) practiced Tuesday; OC Ryan Grubb 'pretty confident' he'll be fine (Bama247 via Heavy, Nov 10). Vanderbilt QB Jared Curtis healthy.

No QB absences: Tennessee's George MacIntyre and Texas A&M's Marcel Reed (Mike Elko backing him, Nov 8). Tennessee TE Ethan Davis out for the season; TE DaSaahn Brame should be OK (Josh Heupel, Nov 10). Texas A&M WR Terry Bussey and OL Blake Ivy out for the season.

Missouri QB Austin Simmons briefly left vs Texas with a leg injury and returned (no update yet); WR Cayden Lee (knee, no structural damage) will try to practice; DL Langden Kitchen out for the season (Eli Drinkwitz, Nov 10). Georgia OLB Amaris Williams out; RB Chauncey Bowens not 100% (AJC, Nov 9).
Ole Miss without RG Patrick Kutas and RB Kewan Lacy (Pete Golding, Nov 9). Oklahoma keeps QB John Mateer; WR Trell Harris not expected back this season (Brent Venables, Nov 10).

Florida QB unresolved: Jon Sumrall won't name a starter between Tramell Jones Jr. and Aaron Philo; both are splitting first-team reps (Athlon via Yahoo, Nov 10). Neither is injured. No Kentucky absences confirmed.

Texas: RB Hollywood Smothers out for the season; WR Cam Coleman (shoulder) was questionable and didn't play last week (Athlon/ESPN, Nov 7). LSU QB Sam Leavitt healthy; RT Weston Davis was helped off vs Alabama (ESPN, Nov 7), status not updated.
South Carolina QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) expected to play; Shane Beamer's 'concern level is very low' (247Sports, Nov 8). Arkansas QB KJ Jackson remains the starter. Watch Wednesday's SEC report.
BYU QB Bear Bachmeier expected to play; RB LJ Martin 'wasn't 100%', TE Will Zundel likely out (Kalani Sitake, Deseret News, Nov 9). Baylor QB DJ Lagway healthier (Dallas Morning News, Nov 9).
No QB absences (Utah's Devon Dampier, Arizona's Noah Fifita). Utah RB Wayshawn Parker (heel) 'gonna be fine' (Morgan Scalley, Nov 10).
No reported absences confirmed yet. Texas Tech QB Thomas Castellanos starts (KCBD, Nov 10); Oklahoma State QB Drew Mestemaker healthy (News9, Nov 10).

Iowa: Cannon Leonard out for the season; CB Jaylen Watson 'going to be okay'; C Cael Winter the only one 'really in doubt', a game-time decision (Kirk Ferentz transcript, Nov 10). Hank Brown at QB. No Purdue absences confirmed.

Oregon State QB Braden Atkinson (right hand, hurt Nov 7) questionable; JaMarcus Shephard 'hopefully he'll be ready', Maalik Murphy would start otherwise. Boise State QB Maddux Madsen (knee) could return; Max Cutforth started last week (Boise State On SI, Nov 9). Both injuries predate the line; no adjustment until statuses are known.

UNLV QB uncertain: Alex Orji replaced Jackson Arnold for three second-half drives vs Wyoming; Dan Mullen says everything is up for evaluation. New Mexico QB Toa Fa'avae starts; LB Jaxton Eck (shoulder) questionable, C Kaden Robnett out for the season (Albuquerque Journal, Nov 9).
